messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — auth provider had 3x latency spikes during model-registry writes yesterday. Postmortem points at synchronized token refresh storms + cloud control-plane flaps. Need clear owners for mitigations.
Nikita: Confirming. Spikes were 03:12–03:18 UTC, correlated with our batch metadata update job + retry fanout. Logs show many simultaneous token refresh calls.
Samir: I can take retry/backoff hardening. Plan: add exponential backoff + full jitter, cap retries per request, and limit concurrent sync workers. ETA: PR by Fri EOD.
Mia: I'll own the model-registry client change: add a cached token store and graceful 429 handling. Target: next sprint Weds.
Leo: I'll add a synthetic canary that exercises auth token path and a latency alert. Also wire a runbook link into the alert. ETA: tomorrow AM.
Jordan: Owner + timeline noted. Also need recurring-incident tracking — who owns the weekly pattern review?
Nikita: Ops cadence suggestion: assign to the third-party-ops rotation. I'll put Samir on for the next 2 weeks, then hand to Mia.
Samir: :thumbsup: I'll also add a smoke test that simulates token expiry storms and add it to CI.
Mia: Can we add an automatic routing fallback to a dedicated model variant on repeated auth errors? That would reduce customer-visible errors during provider degradation.
Leo: We have a routing policy that supports fallback to the local quantized replica. Need product signoff for perf/cost tradeoffs. I can prototype the fallback logic.
Jordan: I'll loop in @product-review tomorrow. For immediate impact prioritize the client and retry changes.
ops-bot: Created task: [AUTH-498] "Retry jitter & cap" assigned to Samir, due 2026-03-27. https://jira/redwood/AUTH-498
Nikita: Also: rotate provider credential TTL. Current TTL 24h causes synchronized refreshes. Proposal: shorten TTL, stagger issuance, and add issuance jitter.
Samir: Agree. We'll also implement client-side random offset before refresh to avoid thundering herds.
Mia: Adding to model-registry plan: token cache TTL -> 2h, prefetch refresh at 10m before expiry + random 0–5m jitter. Will put a changelog note.
Jordan: Action summary (copy to JIRA):
- Samir: retry/backoff PR by Fri EOD (AUTH-498)
- Mia: model-registry token cache + 2h TTL by next Wed
- Leo: canary + dashboard alert + runbook link by tomorrow AM
- Nikita: ops rotation + schedule weekly recurrence review
Runbook: https://confluence/redwood/incident-auth-osc
Samir: I'll drop the smoke-test command in the repo README:
```
# simulate token storm
python tests/simulate_token_storm.py --concurrency 200 --ttl-expiry 5
```
Nikita: Scheduling a 15m retro on Mon to look for recurrence and validate mitigations. Calendar invite will be sent.
Jordan: Thanks all — keep updates in this thread. If any regression appears, escalate to #incidents and ping me directly.
Mia: :rocket:
ops-bot: Note: action [AUTH-498] status -> in-progress (updated by Samir)
